title: Observability Watchtower Terraform module: lifecycle, rollout safety, and health automation
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a composable Terraform module (observability-watchtower) for the VPC/private deployment path that installs and manages the Prometheus stack, Grafana provisioning, an OpenTelemetry Collector (OTel), and log shipping agents. The module must be opinionated enough to be production safe but flexible for Dedicated and Private customers. Focus areas: upgrade safety, automated health probes and remediation hooks, CI gating, and a small-scope migration story for existing clusters.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes clear inputs for: prometheus operator toggles, grafana provisioning JSONs, otel collector config bundle, log shipper provider (fluentbit/vector) selection, and storage backend settings (S3/GCS) as strings.
Module supports a canary rollout strategy via 'strategy = canary' flag that creates a limited replica subset and verifies health before scaling.

Automated health checks: readiness/liveness probes for OTel and log shipper, prometheus alert rules added for scrape failures, and a lifecycle hook that can trigger a rollback or reroute metrics to fallback endpoints.
Provide a preflight 'plan-validator' pipeline step (CI) that runs terraform plan + custom validator and fails on unsafe drifts (storage replacement, state rename).
Comprehensive example usage in examples/ with minimal and advanced flavors, and a migration guide (runbook) for clusters with existing observability resources.
Unit tests for the module using terratest or kitchen-terraform and an integration smoke test that deploys to a disposable namespace and verifies metrics ingest and dashboard provisioning.
Documentation page linked in the Console runbook and a reference PR that adds the module to the private-deploy registry.
No regression in current Dedicated customers using earlier observability modules (compat shim available).

notes_and_tradeoffs: We intentionally separate 'provisioning' from 'runtime config' so customers can bring their own dashboards. Chose canary+health-hook over immediate blue-green to reduce storage duplication costs. Decided to treat storage provider changes as a forced manual approval path (terraform plan will error unless override flag set).
